//installCommand: @library/db generate is NOT optional. This app imports @library/core, which imports named Prisma types (MemberType, CopyCondition, Issue) from @library/db — and @library/db re-exports them from packages/library-db/generated/client, which is gitignored and produced only by `prisma generate`. Locally that directory already exists, so every gate passes; on Vercel it does not, and the ncc bundle fails with 'Module "@library/db" has no exported member MemberType' plus a cascade of implicit-any errors as inference collapses. That is the exact local-gate-vs-cloud-gate gap this project has been bitten by before.
installCommand: cd ../.. && NODE_ENV=development pnpm install --frozen-lockfile=false && pnpm --filter @skoolos/db generate && pnpm --filter @library/db generate && node apps/api/scripts/deref-pnpm-symlinks.mjs
